exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (22 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  How often
   2  time
   3  at
   4  How long
   5  fly
   6  How many
   7  on
   8  watch
   9  has ... at
  10  on
  11  never
  12  How much
  13  does
  14  doesn't
  15  but
  16  quarter
  17  Do
  18  because ... goes
  19  How old
  20  do

⚠ 1, 4, 6, 12, 17, 19-bandlar GAP BOShIDA
turadi → kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── 'HOW ...?' SAVOLLARI ────

  Bu mashqda BEShTA 'How ...?' savoli bor —
  har biri BOShQA narsani so'raydi:

 1  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the theatre?'
    → QANChA TEZ-TEZ
    Javob: 'Twice a month.'

 4  'HOW LONG do kangaroos live?'
    → QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
    Javob: 'Up to fifteen years.'

 6  'HOW MANY legs has a tiger got?'
    → NECHTA (sanaladigan ot)
    Javob: 'Four.'

12  'HOW MUCH does a sea lion weigh?'
    → QANChA (sanalmaydigan: og'irlik,
      pul)

19  'HOW OLD are you?'
    → NECHA YOShDA
    Javob: 'I'm thirty-nine.'

  ⚠ HOW MANY ↔ HOW MUCH:
     HOW MANY + KO'PLIK ot (legs, books)
     HOW MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN
        (money, water, weight)


──── VAQT PREDLOGLARI ────

 3  'He usually plays football AT the
     weekend.'
    ⚠ Britaniya inglizchasida 'AT the
    weekend'; Amerikada 'ON the weekend'.

 7  'She was born ON 2nd August, 1991.'
    ANIQ SANA bilan → ON.

 9b 'He always has lunch AT two o'clock.'
    SOAT bilan → AT.

10  'He never wakes up early ON Sundays.'
    KUN bilan → ON.

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     AT + soat        (at 2 o'clock)
     ON + kun/sana    (on Sunday, on 2nd
                       August)
     IN + oy/yil/fasl (in August, in 1991)


──── PRESENT SIMPLE ────

13  'What DOES he do? — He's a student.'
    'he' → DOES.

14  'Jane likes cats but she DOESN'T like
     dogs.'
    'she' → DOESN'T + asosiy shakl.

17  'DO you like your job?'
    'you' → DO.

18b 'she GOES to the disco'
    'she' → GOES ('-ES' bilan, chunki fe'l
    '-o' ga tugaydi).

20  'What DO you do in your free time?'
    ⚠ IKKI 'do': birinchisi YORDAMChI,
    ikkinchisi ASOSIY fe'l.


──── TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI ────

11  'He NEVER eats meat. He hates it.'
    KALIT: 'He HATES it' — demak umuman
    yemaydi → NEVER.

    ⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
       'He NEVER eats.'  ✓
       'He eats never.'  ✗
    Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN:
       'He IS NEVER late.'


──── BOG'LOVChILAR ────

15  'He likes reading, BUT he doesn't like
     fishing.'
    QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.

18a 'She likes Sundays BECAUSE she goes to
     the disco.'
    SABAB → BECAUSE.


──── LUG'AT ────

 2  'What TIME do the shops open in Holland?'
    'What time ...?' = soat nechchida?

 5  'Penguins have got wings, but they can't
     FLY.'
    ⚠ Pingvinlarning qanoti bor, lekin
    UChA OLMAYDI — bu mashhur fakt.

 8  'Do you usually WATCH TV in the evening?'
    ⚠ 'WATCH TV' — 'see' yoki 'look' EMAS!
       watch TV / watch a film
       see a friend
       look AT a picture

 9a 'He always HAS lunch ...'
    'have lunch' = tushlik qilmoq.

16  'The plane arrives at a QUARTER to
     seven.'
    'a quarter to seven' = yettiga chorak
    kam (06:45).


⚠ 16-BAND — SOATNI AYTISh:

  'a QUARTER TO seven'  = 06:45
  'a QUARTER PAST six'  = 06:15
  'HALF PAST six'       = 06:30
  'six o'clock'         = 06:00

  TO — soat yarmidan KEYIN (kam)
  PAST — soat yarmigacha (o'tdi)

  3-mashqning 1-bandi ham shu:
  'It's a quarter to five.' (04:45)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a theatre  = teatr
  twice      = ikki marta
  Holland    = Gollandiya
  a kangaroo = kenguru
  up to      = ... gacha
  a penguin  = pingvin
  wings      = qanotlar
  a tiger    = yo'lbars
  to be born = tug'ilmoq
  a sea lion = dengiz sheri
  to weigh   = og'irligi bo'lmoq
  to hate    = yomon ko'rmoq
  fishing    = baliq ovlash
  a disco    = diskoteka
  free time  = bo'sh vaqt
  a quarter  = chorak

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B mice
   2  C finishes
   3  B goes
   4  B Excuse
   5  C catches
   6  B for
   7  B has
   8  C until
   9  C earns
  10  B feed


⚠ 1-BAND — MANTIQAN G'ALATI, LEKIN
GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN ANIQ:

  'HAVE ......... got feathers?'

  Sichqonlarda PAT YO'Q — savol mantiqan
  g'alati. Lekin mashq GRAMMATIKANI
  tekshiradi:

     'HAVE' — KO'PLIK ega talab qiladi
        → MICE  ✓
     'mouse' — birlik, 'HAS' kerak bo'lardi
        ✗
     'mouse's' — egalik shakli, EGA bo'la
        olmaydi ✗

  Savolning javobi: 'No, they HAVEN'T.'

  ⚠ 'mouse' ning ko'pligi — MICE
  (noto'g'ri ko'plik!)
     mouse → mice
     man → men,  woman → women
     child → children,  foot → feet
     tooth → teeth,  goose → geese


QOLGANLARI NEGA:

 2  'The film starts at 9 and FINISHES at
     10:30.'
    'start' ning zidi — 'finish'.
    'begins' — 'starts' bilan bir xil ma'no
       (takror bo'lardi).
    'completes' — 'tugatmoq' (obyekt kerak).

 3  'He GOES to work BY car.'
    ⚠ 'BY car' bo'lgani uchun 'goes' kerak.
    'DRIVES to work by car' — takror
       ('drive' o'zi mashinada demakdir).
    'arrives to work' — XATO ('arrive AT
       work').

 4  'EXCUSE me, what's the time?'
    ⚠ Notanish odamga murojaat → 'Excuse
    me'.
    'Sorry' — uzr so'rash (xato qilganda).
    'Thanks' — minnatdorchilik.

 5  'He CATCHES the bus to work at 7:30.'
    ⚠ 'CATCH a bus/train' = avtobusga
    ulgurmoq.
    'goes the bus' — XATO (predlogsiz
       bo'lmaydi).
    'has the bus' — mantiqsiz.

 6  'She is never late FOR school.'
    'be late FOR' — turg'un birikma.

 7  'He HAS a shower before he goes to bed.'
    ⚠ 'HAVE a shower' (Britaniya) yoki
    'TAKE a shower' (Amerika).
    'make a shower' / 'do a shower' — XATO.

 8  'Post offices are open from 9 am UNTIL
     3pm.'
    'from ... UNTIL/TILL/TO ...' — vaqt
    oralig'i.
    'from ... at' / 'from ... for' — XATO.

 9  'She likes her job a lot because she
     EARNS a lot of money.'
    ⚠ 'EARN money' = ishlab pul topmoq.
    'win money' = yutuq yutmoq (lotereya).
    'do money' — mavjud emas.

10  'Mammals FEED their babies ON milk.'
    ⚠ 'FEED somebody ON something' =
    kimnidir biror narsa bilan boqmoq.
    'eat' — o'zi yemoq (bola o'zi yeydi,
       ona boqmaydi).
    'give' — 'give milk TO their babies'
       bo'lardi (predlog boshqa).


⚠ 'FEED' va 'EAT' FARQI:
  FEED = BOQMOQ (boshqani)
     'Mammals FEED their babies.'
  EAT = YEMOQ (o'zi)
     'The baby EATS.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  feathers   = patlar
  a mouse (mice) = sichqon(lar)
  to finish  = tugamoq
  to begin   = boshlamoq
  Excuse me  = kechirasiz
  to catch a bus = avtobusga ulgurmoq
  a shower   = dush
  a post office = pochta bo'limi
  until      = ... gacha
  to earn    = ishlab topmoq
  a mammal   = sut emizuvchi
  to feed    = boqmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT'S THE TIME?'
       (yoki 'What time is it?')
    B: 'It's a quarter to five.'

 2  A: 'WHAT'S THIS?' (yoki 'What animal is
       it?')
    B: 'It's a deer.'

 3  A: 'WHAT DO YOU DO?'
    B: 'I'm a singer.'

 4  A: 'HOW OFTEN DO YOU EAT CHOCOLATE?'
    B: 'Never. I hate eating chocolate.'

 5  A: 'WHEN WAS SHE BORN?'
    B: 'She was born on 13th July, 1989.'


QANDAY TOPILADI — JAVOBGA QARANG:

 1  'It's a QUARTER TO FIVE.' — SOAT.
    → 'What's the time?' /
      'What time is it?'

    (1-mashqning 16-bandi ham soat haqida
     edi: 'a quarter to seven'.)

 2  'It's a DEER.' — HAYVON.
    → 'What's this?' / 'What animal is it?'

 3  'I'm a SINGER.' — KASB.
    → 'What do you do?'

    ⚠ 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?
    (1-mashqning 13-bandi: 'What does he
     do? — He's a student.')

 4  'NEVER. I hate eating chocolate.' —
    ChASTOTA.
    → 'How often do you eat chocolate?'

    ⚠ 'Never' — 'How often ...?' savoliga
    javob (1-mashqning 1-bandi bilan bir
    xil).

 5  'She was BORN ON 13th July, 1989.' —
    SANA.
    → 'When was she born?'

    ⚠ 'BE BORN' — majhul nisbat:
       'She WAS BORN.'  ✓
       'She born.'      ✗
       'She was borned.' ✗


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLAR — 'DO' NING IKKI ROLI:

  3  'What DO you DO?'
     birinchi 'do' — YORDAMChI
     ikkinchi 'do' — ASOSIY fe'l

  4  'How often DO you EAT chocolate?'
     'do' — yordamchi, 'eat' — asosiy fe'l


⚠ 4-BANDDAGI 'HATE + -ING':
  'I hate EATING chocolate.'
  'hate/like/love + V-ing'

  1-mashqning 11-bandi: 'He never eats meat.
  He HATES it.'


DIQQAT — 'A DEER':
  'deer' — birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham BIR
  XIL!
     one deer / two deer  ✓
     two deers  ✗

  Shunga o'xshash: sheep, fish, aircraft.


DIQQAT — SOATNI AYTISh:
  'a quarter to five' = 04:45
  'a quarter past four' = 04:15
  'half past four' = 04:30


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a deer     = kiyik (ko'pligi ham 'deer')
  a singer   = qo'shiqchi
  chocolate  = shokolad
  to hate    = yomon ko'rmoq
  to be born = tug'ilmoq

1-mashqning 7-bandi ham shu qurilma.

items.base: a deer / a sheep / a fish

items.derived: see a friend / look AT a picture

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW OFTEN + DO/DOES + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  Twice a month. / Never.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you go to the theatre? — Twice a month.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teatrga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Oyiga ikki marta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javoblari: always, usually, often, sometimes,
never; once/twice a week.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many legs has a tiger got? How much does a sea lion weigh?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarsning nechta oyog'i bor? Dengiz sherining og'irligi qancha?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOW MANY — sanaladigan;
HOW MUCH — sanalmaydigan (pul, suv, og'irlik).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jane likes cats but she doesn't like dogs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jeyn mushuklarni yoqtiradi, lekin itlarni yoqtirmaydi.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat.
'She born' / 'She was borned' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: What DO you DO?  —  I'm a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you do? — I'm a singer.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI 'do': yordamchi + asosiy fe'l.
'What do you do IN YOUR FREE TIME?' — boshqa
ma'no (mashg'ulot).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a quarter to five. The plane arrives at a quarter to seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soat beshga chorak kam. Samolyot yettiga chorak kam keladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TO — soat yarmidan keyin (kam);
PAST — soat yarmigacha (o'tdi).
